title: ULDM Eigenmode Toolkit
description:
Python library for computing the eigenfunctions f_nl(r) of a soliton potential and the spectral coefficients c_nlm(t) of ultralight dark matter (ULDM) wavefunctions from PyUL_SK simulations: eigen solver, one-pass a_lm kernel on radial shells, c_nlm integration (resumable local pipeline uldm-cnlm and inline recording during a PyUL_SK run), PyUL run and trajectory loaders, time and frequency analysis, and scripts (paper_figures/) that regenerate all 13 printed figures of the paper Stone Skipping Black Holes in Ultralight Dark Matter Solitons (A. Zhang, Y. Wang, J. L. Zagorac and R. Easther, arXiv:2602.11512) from the published data products.

Default options reproduce the published numbers. The conventions of the published analysis and the known issues of the code versions behind the figures are documented in docs/conventions_and_errata.md; all changes are listed in CHANGELOG.md. The unit conversions are adapted from PyUltraLight / PyUltraLight 2 (see NOTICE).
